title: 真实Grafana子路径恢复：HTML之外验证资源、登录Cookie与Live升级
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 检查浏览器实际资源URL与代理转发路径，统一root_url、子路径处理和代理规则。
使用现有配置能力修正后验证静态资源、登录回调和Live连接。

conversion.original_title: 经/grafana访问首页200但JS资源404，root_url未包含子路径。如何恢复？

body:
## 操作任务
实现set_public_root(config,approved_url)，只修正私有配置唯一root_url行为批准的http://127.0.0.1:端口/grafana/。固定反向代理仅接收/grafana/并剥去此前缀，其他路径404，HTTP和WebSocket代理路径不能改；Grafana默认serve_from_sub_path=false保留。原root_url缺前缀时登录HTML200，但实际生成的JS/CSS请求走根路径404。保留配置其他每一字节及0600、用户和权限；symlink或非文件、URL非批准loopback /grafana/、重复root_url拒绝。由夹具实际重启后验收所有页面引用的本地JS/CSS真实200（不能是HTML兜底）、实际密码登录的Cookie Path、该Cookie读取原身份、正确Origin的Live WebSocket101和错误Origin403。不得把首页200当作恢复，不得重复/grafana/前缀。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Grafana11.6.0私有SQLite/默认身份、固定loopback HTTP反向代理、真实静态资源、密码登录及Live握手。验证浏览器HTML URL解析规则及实际HTTP响应，不宣称全量浏览器绘图、第三方OAuth/SSO回调、TLS终止或生产代理产品兼容性。101原子路径故障与102副本密钥故障分别验证，不重复计共享服务夹具。

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源

test_files.checks/check.py:
import base64,hashlib,html.parser,json,os,pathlib,re,secrets,socket,sys,urllib.parse
sys.path[:0]=[os.getcwd(),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
import task
from grafana_native import PrivateGrafana
from prefix_proxy import PrefixProxy
class Assets(html.parser.HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self):super().__init__();self.base='/';self.assets=[]
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  attrs=dict(attrs)
  if tag=='base':self.base=attrs.get('href','/')
  if tag=='script' and attrs.get('src'):self.assets.append(attrs['src'])
  if tag=='link' and attrs.get('rel')=='stylesheet' and attrs.get('href'):self.assets.append(attrs['href'])
def resources(proxy):
 status,headers,body=proxy.request('GET','/grafana/login')
 assert status==200,'login HTML should render'
 parser=Assets();parser.feed(body.decode());assert parser.assets
 base=urllib.parse.urljoin(proxy.url,parser.base)
 paths=[urllib.parse.urlsplit(urllib.parse.urljoin(base,name)).path for name in parser.assets]
 return parser,paths
def identity(server):
 status,user=server.request('GET','/api/user');assert status==200
 return {k:user[k] for k in ('id','login','orgId','isGrafanaAdmin')}
with PrefixProxy() as proxy:
 def prepare(server):
  proxy.backend_port=server.port
  server.config.write_text(server.config.read_text().replace('root_url = '+server.url+'/','root_url = '+proxy.origin+'/'))
 with PrivateGrafana(prepare) as grafana:
  before=grafana.config.read_bytes();principal=identity(grafana)
  parser,paths=resources(proxy)
  assert parser.base=='/' and any(not p.startswith('/grafana/') for p in paths)
  outside=next(p for p in paths if not p.startswith('/grafana/'))
  assert proxy.request('GET',outside)[0]==404
  print('NATIVE_GRAFANA_SUBPATH_ACTUAL_ASSET404_WITH_WRONG_ROOT_URL',flush=True)
  print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:align_only_public_root_with_fixed_prefix_stripping_proxy_then_actual_restart',flush=True)
  task.set_public_root(grafana.config,proxy.url)
  after=grafana.config.read_bytes()
  def without_root(value):return re.sub(rb'(?m)^root_url[ \t]*=[^\r\n]*$',b'root_url = <same-field>',value)
  assert without_root(before)==without_root(after) and grafana.config.stat().st_mode&0o777==0o600
  grafana.stop();grafana.start()
  parser,paths=resources(proxy)
  assert parser.base=='/grafana/' and all(p.startswith('/grafana/public/') for p in paths),paths
  assert any(p.endswith('.js') for p in paths) and any(p.endswith('.css') for p in paths)
  for path in paths:
   code,headers,body=proxy.request('GET',path)
   assert code==200 and len(body)>100,'real built resource missing: '+path
   assert not body.lstrip().startswith(b'<!doctype html'),'HTML fallback is not a valid JS/CSS resource'
  # Real password login and cookie-scoped callback, without BasicAuth on the next request.
  code,headers,body=proxy.request('POST','/grafana/login',json.dumps(dict(user=grafana.user,password=grafana.password)),
    {'Content-Type':'application/json','Origin':proxy.origin})
  assert code==200,(code,body[:150])
  cookies=[v for k,v in headers if k.lower()=='set-cookie' and v.startswith('grafana_session=')]
  assert len(cookies)==1 and re.search(r'(?i);\s*path=/grafana(?:;|$)',cookies[0]),'session cookie path does not match public subpath'
  cookie=cookies[0].split(';',1)[0]
  code,headers,body=proxy.request('GET','/grafana/api/user',headers={'Cookie':cookie})
  assert code==200 and {k:json.loads(body)[k] for k in principal}==principal
  def live(origin):
   key=base64.b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(16)).decode()
   with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',proxy.port),timeout=5) as connection:
    request=('GET /grafana/api/live/ws HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 127.0.0.1:'+str(proxy.port)+
      '\r\nUpgrade: websocket\r\nConnection: Upgrade\r\nSec-WebSocket-Key: '+key+
      '\r\nSec-WebSocket-Version: 13\r\nCookie: '+cookie+'\r\nOrigin: '+origin+'\r\n\r\n')
    connection.sendall(request.encode());response=b''
    while b'\r\n\r\n' not in response:
     chunk=connection.recv(4096);assert chunk;response+=chunk
   head=response.split(b'\r\n\r\n',1)[0].decode()
   return head,key
  rejected,_=live('http://unapproved.invalid');assert ' 403 ' in rejected.splitlines()[0]
  accepted,key=live(proxy.origin);assert ' 101 ' in accepted.splitlines()[0],accepted
  expected=base64.b64encode(hashlib.sha1((key+'258EAFA5-E914-47DA-95CA-C5AB0DC85B11').encode()).digest()).decode()
  assert any(line.lower()=='sec-websocket-accept: '+expected.lower() for line in accepted.splitlines())
  assert identity(grafana)==principal and grafana.config.read_bytes()==after
  print('NATIVE_GRAFANA_SUBPATH_ASSETS_LOGIN_AND_LIVE_RECOVERED',flush=True)
  print('NATIVE_REAL_CSS_JS_200_SESSION_COOKIE_SCOPE_AUTHENTICATED_USER_WEBSOCKET101_WRONG_ORIGIN403_IDENTITY_PRESERVED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
